metadata.name: JansenRitUnit
metadata.author: Jansen, B. H. & Rit, V. G.
metadata.description: Six-state cortical-column neural mass with equation-(6) connectivity and explicit-Euler integration

dynamics.y5: b_exc * b_rate * c4 * (2.0 * e0 / (1.0 + exp(r * (v0 - c3 * y0)))) - 2.0 * b_rate * y5 - b_rate**2 * y2

extensions.discretisation: Explicit Euler at 0.1 ms; the publication defines the continuous equations and does not require this solver
extensions.connectivity_note: C2=0.8*C1 and C3=C4=0.25*C1; C1 is inside the excitatory sigmoid and C2 multiplies its output
extensions.sigmoid_note: The maintained e0=2.5 is half the maximum rate, so 2*e0 is equivalent to the source implementation's e0=5
extensions.output_note: The continuous EEG proxy is y1-y2; no binary spike semantics are claimed
